name: Portfolio Performance
description: Portfolio Performance enables an Eclipse p2 in-app update operation against its HTTPS update site. UpdateHelper registers and refreshes p2 metadata and artifact repositories and runs provisioning after confirmation; active bundle-signing trust roots and released signatures remain delegated to external p2/JRE configuration.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot, not historical release re-verification.
Active p2/JRE certificate trust root and released signed bundles are not independently verified.
No claim is made about current release signing.
